sections.title: About
sections.content: I Might Be An Idiot follows my determined search for popularity as I maintain trails in Arizona following a suspension from my private arts Pennsylvania college.

paragraphs.text: When things get worse it forces me to search for the reason why all these things kept happening to me. In the end… well, you read the title.

items.title: Holes
items.description: by Louis Sachar – Light-hearted hero journey of juvenile delinquents doing manual labor in the desert.

items.title: Wild
items.description: by Cheryl Strayed – Memoir of a woman who resolves conflict with a series of flashbacks.

items.title: David Sedaris
items.description: Inspiration for humor and family commentary from works like Me Talk Pretty One Day and Calypso.
